request.description:
## All — Get General Ledger

Retrieves the general ledger entries for a specified date range.

**Method:** `GET`  
**URL:** `{{base_url}}/v1/general-ledger`

---

### Authentication

This request requires a Bearer token. Set the `accessToken` variable in your active environment before sending.

| Type | Token |
| --- | --- |
| Bearer Token | `{{accessToken}}` |

---

### Query Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Format | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `startDate` | string | ✅ Yes | `YYYY-MM-DD` | The start date of the ledger period (e.g. `2026-04-04`) |
| `endDate` | string | ✅ Yes | `YYYY-MM-DD` | The end date of the ledger period (e.g. `2026-04-10`) |

---

### Response — `200 OK`

Returns the general ledger data for the queried period.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `startDate` | string | The start date of the queried period |
| `endDate` | string | The end date of the queried period |
| `periodLockInfo` | object | Information about the locked/closed period |
| `periodLockInfo.name` | string | Name of the period |
| `periodLockInfo.type` | string | Type of the period |
| `periodLockInfo.startDate` | string | Start date of the locked period |
| `periodLockInfo.endDate` | string | End date of the locked period |
| `accounts` | array | List of account entries in the ledger |

**Each entry in** **`accounts`** **contains:**

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `account.id` | string | Unique identifier of the account |
| `account.accountNumber` | string | Account number |
| `account.name` | string | Account name |
| `account.category` | string | Account category |
| `account.isContra` | boolean | Whether the account is a contra account |
| `openingBalance` | number | Balance before the start date |
| `transactions` | array | List of transactions within the period |
| `periodDebit` | number | Total debit amount for the period |
| `periodCredit` | number | Total credit amount for the period |
| `closingBalance` | number | Total opening balance + running balance |

**Each entry in** **`transactions`** **contains:**

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `transactionDate` | string | Date of the transaction |
| `transactionNumber` | string | Transaction reference number |
| `description` | string | Description of the transaction |
| `debit` | number | Debit amount |
| `credit` | number | Credit amount |
| `balance` | number | Running balance after the transaction |
| `journalId` | string | Associated journal entry ID |

request.description:
## All — Get General Ledger

Retrieves the general ledger entries for a specified date range.

**Method:** `GET`  
**URL:** `{{base_url}}/v1/general-ledger`

---

### Authentication

This request requires a Bearer token. Set the `accessToken` variable in your active environment before sending.

| Type | Token |
| --- | --- |
| Bearer Token | `{{accessToken}}` |

---

### Query Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Format | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `startDate` | string | ✅ Yes | `YYYY-MM-DD` | The start date of the ledger period (e.g. `2026-04-04`) |
| `endDate` | string | ✅ Yes | `YYYY-MM-DD` | The end date of the ledger period (e.g. `2026-04-10`) |

---

### Response — `200 OK`

Returns the general ledger data for the queried period.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `startDate` | string | The start date of the queried period |
| `endDate` | string | The end date of the queried period |
| `periodLockInfo` | object | Information about the locked/closed period |
| `periodLockInfo.name` | string | Name of the period |
| `periodLockInfo.type` | string | Type of the period |
| `periodLockInfo.startDate` | string | Start date of the locked period |
| `periodLockInfo.endDate` | string | End date of the locked period |
| `accounts` | array | List of account entries in the ledger |

**Each entry in** **`accounts`** **contains:**

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `account.id` | string | Unique identifier of the account |
| `account.accountNumber` | string | Account number |
| `account.name` | string | Account name |
| `account.category` | string | Account category |
| `account.isContra` | boolean | Whether the account is a contra account |
| `openingBalance` | number | Balance before the start date |
| `transactions` | array | List of transactions within the period |
| `periodDebit` | number | Total debit amount for the period |
| `periodCredit` | number | Total credit amount for the period |
| `closingBalance` | number | Total opening balance + running balance |

**Each entry in** **`transactions`** **contains:**

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `transactionDate` | string | Date of the transaction |
| `transactionNumber` | string | Transaction reference number |
| `description` | string | Description of the transaction |
| `debit` | number | Debit amount |
| `credit` | number | Credit amount |
| `balance` | number | Running balance after the transaction |
| `journalId` | string | Associated journal entry ID |
